tools.name: stamped_list_customers
tools.description: Filter and list customer records (email, name, tags, addresses, loyalty activity summary such as points and VIP tier). All filters are optional. V3 API: only for shops on the Stamped Loyalty 2.0 dashboard. GET /api/v3/merchant/shops/{shopId}/customers.

tools.name: stamped_get_customer
tools.description: One customer record by Stamped customer id (customerId from stamped_list_customers). V3 API. GET /api/v3/merchant/shops/{shopId}/customers/{customerId}.

tools.name: stamped_lookup_customer
tools.description: Find one customer by email or by a platform id (give exactly one). V3 API. GET /api/v3/merchant/shops/{shopId}/customers/lookup.

tools.name: stamped_list_products
tools.description: Filter and list the product catalog Stamped holds (title, vendor, type, handle, status, tags). All filters are optional. V3 API. GET /api/v3/merchant/shops/{shopId}/products.

tools.name: stamped_get_product
tools.description: One product by Stamped product id (productId from stamped_list_products). V3 API. GET /api/v3/merchant/shops/{shopId}/products/{productId}.

tools.name: stamped_lookup_product
tools.description: Find one product by a platform id (give exactly one). V3 API. GET /api/v3/merchant/shops/{shopId}/products/lookup.

tools.name: stamped_list_orders
tools.description: List order records Stamped holds (customer id, currency, line items and cart states, discounts applied, dates). Paged; Stamped documents no filters for this list, use stamped_lookup_order for one order. V3 API. GET /api/v3/merchant/shops/{shopId}/orders.

tools.name: stamped_get_order
tools.description: One order by Stamped order id (orderId from stamped_list_orders). V3 API. GET /api/v3/merchant/shops/{shopId}/orders/{orderId}.

tools.name: stamped_lookup_order
tools.description: Find one order by a platform order id (give exactly one). V3 API. GET /api/v3/merchant/shops/{shopId}/orders/lookup.

tools.name: stamped_list_loyalty_rewards
tools.description: Loyalty program report: the rewards customers earned or redeemed (title, type, value, status, expiry, customer id, and the coupon code MASKED: only the last 4 characters are shown, codes shorter than 10 characters are fully hidden, and coupon_code_masked is true in the reply). Read-only audit view;

tools.name: stamped_list_loyalty_activities
tools.description: Loyalty program report: the points ledger of activities (rule, points credited/debited, event, order id and order breakdown, customer id). Read-only audit view; no points are changed. V3 API (Loyalty 2.0). GET /api/v3/loyalty/shops/{shopId}/activities.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: stamped_list_customers, stamped_lookup_customer · Private data: stamped_list_customers, stamped_get_customer, stamped_list_orders · Public sink: stamped_list_customers, stamped_lookup_customer.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: stamped_list_customers, stamped_lookup_customer · Private data: stamped_list_customers, stamped_get_customer, stamped_list_orders · Public sink: stamped_list_customers, stamped_lookup_customer

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
